journeys.oracle: Actual native built artifacts run in workerd; real Chromium independently confirms the exact RPC endpoint, no initial/replayed call, no trace/cookie headers and the retained answer. The API artifact contains the engine marker while browser artifacts must not. The generated native settings identity, short request marker and source-built internal defect require actual responses and positive fixed reporting; removing the owning failure boundary makes marker reflection fail the saved test. Unknown native function-address requests must return empty 404 and must omit the short request marker from actual native logs; removing exact-address admission restores that log leak. Actual built API global/procedure/fatal replies use fixed safe values; expected/version errors retain checked identity. A source-built damaged valid-JSON reply must restore a checked error through the genuine Website binding, with real Chromium editing and no replay. Positive fixed host logs omit the marker and pay values. Removal of each native encoder or the owned reply decoder must fail the saved test, followed by exact restoration and fresh dependency/artifact builds. Controlled API roots retain the real calculation/encoding and delay headers or the remaining body for twelve seconds. Actual generated clients must hit the ten-second deadline; Chromium must observe request abort after deadline, editing and actual Back route departure. Removing deadline or edit interruption fails the saved test; exact restoration and fresh builds pass. Pay-value checks inspect emitted log messages; private text checks inspect the whole record. Actual native mock-plan properties and saved real CLI state must contain the disabled collection policy; removing the API graph property fails the saved state Schema after runtime checks. These are declared-state checks, not cloud upload or exported-row proof. An actual successful browser answer survives edits, controlled unavailable retry and invalid form without being presented as current. Reverting figures makes no request and still needs one explicit real RPC to clear the stale message. Actual Worker-generated successful submission HTML hydrates without replay and retains its answer through editing and failed retry. The additional pages must independently return both known results via real API artifacts; no calculation fixture supplies them. Each page starts without the previous calculator's answer. Saved forms and report identity are checked together. Exact browser locator fill admissions have actual CLI positive and neighbouring-application negative fixtures. The size oracle uses multi-byte text below 65536 characters but above 65536 encoded bytes at both API paths and all three form paths. API boundary fixtures also accept exactly 65536 bytes and reject progressive streams without reading their tail. The bounded private client must classify an actual native 413 as the checked request-size error. Valid native calculator/catalogue replies at exactly 2 MiB succeed; over-limit streams stop before the tail and release. Status fixtures prove request-controller abort, safe serialized guidance and one call only. Six restored checked error variants hydrate with their guidance and no new calculation. The built shared-work fixture reaches eight calculations across one HTTP call and a seven-item RPC batch, refuses extra HTTP/SSR/public browser work, retains manual-retry guidance with no edit replay, emits checked HTTP 504/RPC timeouts at five seconds and reaches cleanup. The actual generated client preserves timeout identity. Direct scoped tests prove cancelled/failed place reuse and independent instance pools; timers do not claim forced CPU pre-emption. The owning native pair also reads detail/schema/graph/facts/rules/jurisdictions/tax years from the actual API artifact. The shared RPC corpus proves decoder, size, status, deadline, interruption and old-revision rejection for every named call. Documentation assertions inspect actual initial HTML for every page before independent Chromium navigation. Three source-built API variants retain valid checked pages but change Markdown, metadata or module identity; cold Website SSR and the actual native GET must detect each mismatch. A genuine server-function response is damaged in the browser to prove restoration rejects it. The API artifact must positively contain the executable calculator service identity and browser chunks must omit it; accepted documentation prose cannot stand in for an engine marker. Full-page images supplement functional observations only. Search SSR titles must match real built API results; the original URL resists a forged header. Native function identity is read from its compiled owner. A damaged genuine search reply must fail restoration. Actual form/result navigation and JavaScript-free submission are independently observed in Chromium. Focused browser navigation waits for rendered words before asserting checked outcomes; a bare router promise is insufficient. Bounded startup readiness cannot hide application errors or a persistent gateway failure. Actual built discovery GET bodies must equal the checked native client documents. Chromium XML parsing must produce the sitemap namespace and all 61 canonical addresses in catalogue order. Explicit HEAD 200 must have an empty body and GET-equivalent headers. A real unavailable API binding must return empty uncached 503. The actual RPC corpus rejects a valid document for a different requested path. The Markdown oracle compares all 61 same-page/file GET bodies and equal empty 200 HEAD headers with the owning processed catalogue. Real weighted/quoted/excluded/invalid Accept fields select actual HTML/text or empty safe errors; forged native page headers cannot change the original URL. Chromium independently parses alternate/visible links and opens the real file to exact processed text. Real unavailable binding and method/query/missing cases must fail safely. Share-asset proof reruns the actual build generator, compares every copied and served PNG byte, observes static GET/HEAD/cache/media and exactly accepted paths, decodes all 61 images in Chromium at 1200 by 630, and checks each actual head against the owning TechArticle Schema. Renderer/WebAssembly markers must be absent from Worker and browser outputs; encoded script text preserves unusual characters without closing the script. The actual official MCP network client runs against the source-built Worker, with native JSON/SSE parsing rather than handwritten frames. Its report/page decode through canonical Schemas and equal real HTTP replies; alternating transports exhaust the same local limiter. In-process real-client cancellation separately fills all eight places, cancels one, finishes a replacement and closes the others. This does not prove network cancellation or older session routing. Chrome153 actual native developer-tools events and invoke/cancel commands require real registration and native replies rather than a copied host object. A manual response witness must complete before answer equality. Pending real RPC is held at browser transport to prove busy admission, native caller abort, edit cancellation, successful manual retry and removal of five tools on route exit. Restored non-default pay fields, shared view and next checked request must agree. This is a test-controlled native caller, not an autonomous model session. Actual HeapProfiler collection between departure and return must preserve the distinct annual amount and earlier report without a new request; keeping only registry value nodes cannot satisfy this oracle.
